Good evening departures team,

Mixed spell so far, and the senior handler flagged some notes on visitor flow. I have checked the companion animal intake stack and the handover notes are in acceptable order, though a few entries still need cleaner initials and clearer routing marks. Please keep the desk logs aligned with the live queue, and send any amended kennel or carrier details through the usual channel before the final passenger review. Our records remain useful only when they are precise, legible, and updated without delay.

The safety coordinator has also asked for closer attention to the waiting area, since congestion there has been affecting the welcome team and slowing the escort pattern to the gate. <<FACT F087>> I ask everyone to keep pets and carriers separated from general foot traffic whenever practical, and to record any unusual behavior, spillage, or distress in the notes rather than leaving it to memory. If Ben Cohen or Ethan Bianchi appears on the manifest, please verify the companion animal tags carefully and pass the file to the next desk without hesitation. Trixie remains listed as calm, but that assessment should still be confirmed at handoff.

Please continue to treat each journey as a shared responsibility, with the Companion Animal Travel Desk maintaining steady records and the boarding teams keeping the flow orderly. When a situation changes, mark it at once and avoid informal shorthand that could be misunderstood later. Aurelia Skyways depends on clear reporting, and the present workload will go more smoothly if we keep the same standard through the remaining departures. Thank you for the prompt attention and for keeping the desk professional under pressure.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
